description: This file defines the EventHubSequenceToken class, which represents a sequence token for event hub messages, including offset, sequence number, and event index, and implements related interfaces and serialization features.

classes.name: EventHubSequenceToken
classes.description: A serializable class that encapsulates the position of an event within an EventHub partition, including offset, sequence number, and event index.

methods.name: ToString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the EventHubSequenceToken object, including offset, sequence number, and event index.
